name: netrunner
description: Netrunner: a cyber theme for Claude Code. The whole app's look with a slow network-map background, a status band above the prompt (usage bars, prompt cache WARM/COLD, a WAITING line and a sweep while anything runs) and matching transcript skins, in five variants: Packet Trace, Zero Day, Cold Boot, Black ICE and Red Team.

variant.title: Color variant
variant.description: packet-trace: graphite, teal and violet. zero-day: terminal green and magenta. cold-boot: steel, ice cyan and periwinkle. black-ice: black and white, color kept for errors and warnings. red-team: red-black, deep crimson and ember.

look.title: App look and background
look.description: animated: the variant's colors for the whole app and a slow network map behind the conversation (desktop and mobile apps). still: the same, held still. off: leave the app's own colors and background.

skin.title: Transcript skin
skin.description: apply: switch the skins mod to the variant's skin when you pick a variant. keep: save the five Netrunner skins but leave your current skin alone.

filetree.title: Match filetree
filetree.description: match: when the filetree mod is installed, set its Palette to the variant's colors, so folders and git colors follow the theme. A palette you wrote yourself is left alone. off: never touch filetree's settings.
